text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's like the saying goes, "the
dirt is
always stronger on the other side."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I write sayings in my Chiyonotes.
The little
insights I have every day might
be useful
someday!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that's my proverb. Feel free to
write that
one down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, thank... Wait. Don't speed and
velocity
mean the same thing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Speed is what you gain from
training.
Velocity, you have to work up
to through
exercise!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see! I'd better write that down! "Speed
is..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I feel like training and exercise
also mean the
same thing here...
